{{Quote|What is that, a Z-Ninety-five? How'd you get a hyperspace sled to stay attached to that old girl? We didn't know those antiques still flew.''"<br />"''Still flies, Farpoint control. But it isn't always pretty.|[[Farpoint]] control and Jaden Korr|<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref>}}
This [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]], named '''''Far Wanderer''''',<ref name="Crosscurrent" /> was utilized by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]] throughout<ref name="Jedi Academy" /> his<ref name="Crosscurrent" /> training and involvement in the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] campaign. Modified to include a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] for solo journeys across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Korr [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] from planet to planet when not traveling with his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], [[Kyle Katarn]], aboard the ''[[Raven's Claw]]'', or when utilizing a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. Korr first used it to travel to [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] to investigate the mysterious takeover of the Bakura Power Station with Katarn. However, Korr eventually got fed up with waiting next to ''Far Wanderer'' and decided to investigate on his own. After saving the power station from being destroyed, Korr returned to his ship to report back to the Jedi Academy.<ref name="Jedi Academy" />

By [[41 ABY|41.5]] ABY the Headhunter was still in use by Jaden Korr despite its advanced age and being outdated even in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. However it had been modified to accommodate an [[R6 (Jaden Korr)|R6 Unit]] that could pilot it on its own. Jaden used it to travel to [[Fhost]] after receiving a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]], from there he traveled with the salvage vessel [[Junker (YT-2400 light freighter)|''Junker'']] and ordered his R6 to keep the Headhunter in orbit and contact the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] should he not return within two weeks.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />
